title: EU gas supplier changes, LNG firm financial evidence and attribution boundaries

euSupplierContext.explanation: Descriptive volume ratio only: U.S. gas import growth divided by Russia gas import decline. Not evidence of one-for-one replacement, attributable sales or financial gains.

knownConfounders: Plaquemines LNG facility startup and ramp-up
Average LNG sales price decline in 2025 and H1 2026
Changes in global LNG supply and demand
Changes in EU total gas demand
Contract mix, cargo diversions and derivative accounting

evidenceMatrix.question: Did EU imports from Russia decline?
evidenceMatrix.finding: 153 bcm in 2021 to 36 bcm in 2025; approximate/rounded

evidenceMatrix.question: Did EU imports from the U.S. rise?
evidenceMatrix.finding: 18.9 bcm to 75.6 bcm in same years

evidenceMatrix.question: Did company revenue and operating income rise?
evidenceMatrix.finding: Both Cheniere and Venture Global increased 2024–2025 operating income

evidenceMatrix.question: Was company export growth exclusively due to Europe?
evidenceMatrix.finding: Plaquemines accounted for 96.16% of Venture Global export volume growth 2024–2025; destination not assigned

evidenceMatrix.question: Did higher prices drive Venture Global's growth?
evidenceMatrix.source: SEC company average LNG selling prices
evidenceMatrix.finding: Weighted-average LNG price decreased 2024–2025 and H1 2025–H1 2026

evidenceMatrix.question: What is May 2026 FOB export value?
evidenceMatrix.finding: Five destination hypothetical gross FOB values depend on assumed heating content
